message:
chore: release 2026.10.20 (#14948)

<!-- entire-trail-link-start -->
https://entire.com/gh/jdx/-/trails/2808/changes/mise/1030
<!-- entire-trail-link-end -->

### 🚀 Features

- **(bootstrap)** let Homebrew upgrade casks mise installs by @jdx in
[#14929](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14929)
- **(bootstrap)** manage existing systemd user units from
bootstrap.services by @jdx in
[#14980](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14980)
- **(bootstrap)** install Windows packages with Chocolatey by @jdx in
[#14978](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14978)
- **(bootstrap)** support launchd launch events by @deecewan in
[#14992](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14992)
- **(dotfiles)** render templates in dotfiles.root by @jdx in
[#14969](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14969)
- **(github)** add version_regex to list only matching release tags by
@jdx in [#14984](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14984)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **(backends)** name --global in the switch warning for global lock
entries by @jdx in [#14976](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14976)
- **(bootstrap)** find a just-installed git outside startup PATH by
@pmmmwh in [#14919](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14919)
- **(bootstrap)** pin full container ids when hashing compose service
references by @jdx in [#14958](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14958)
- **(config)** warn about an ignored write_targets only when a write
uses it by @jdx in [#14973](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14973)
- **(doctor)** accept any registry-listed backend for an explicit
install by @jdx in [#14965](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14965)
- **(doctor)** color mise doctor project output by @jdx in
[#14970](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14970)
- **(dot)** show the local history path in status and explain split
track entries by @jdx in
[#14979](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14979)
- **(dot)** resolve a relative dot add --source from the current
directory by @jdx in [#14983](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14983)
- **(env)** avoid sops CLI recursion through mise shims by @shuaiyafei
in [#14801](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14801)
- **(hook-env)** install error hooks before the hook-env fast path by
@jdx in [#14963](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14963)
- **(http)** accept # comment lines in netrc files by @jdx in
[#14964](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14964)
- **(http)** apply Tera filters to {{ version }} in tool option
templates by @jdx in [#14967](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14967)
- **(lock)** keep npm sidecars in one place for a symlinked config dir
by @jdx in [#14961](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14961)
- **(lock)** skip platforms excluded by a tool's os option by @jdx in
[#14959](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14959)
- **(npm)** skip the aube tree health walk in repeated hook-env runs on
Windows by @jdx in [#14960](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14960)
- **(oci)** keep absolute symlink targets in system package layers by
@jdx in [#14968](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14968)
- **(oci)** write aliased tools by their resolved backend in the image
config by @jdx in [#14971](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14971)
- **(self-update)** leave WinGet-managed installs to winget by @jdx in
[#14977](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14977)
- **(shim)** keep command wrappers in place during a concurrent reshim
by @HackingGate in [#14931](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14931)
- **(task)** stop sibling tasks run through Git Bash when a task fails
on Windows by @jdx in [#14966](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14966)

### 📚 Documentation

- **(ide)** add mise-zed, and screenshots of mise-vscode and mise-zed by
@hverlin in [#14988](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14988)
- **(templates)** list the settings that render templates by @jdx in
[#15004](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/15004)
- **(use)** explain that a bare tool reuses the newest installed version
by @sahidvelji in [#14949](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14949)

### 📦️ Dependency Updates

- update aube to v2.8.3 by @renovate[bot] in
[#14957](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14957)
- update jdx crates to v7.1.2 by @renovate[bot] in
[#14934](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14934)

### 📦 Registry

- add packslip and aqua backends to jactionlint by @sahidvelji in
[#14947](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14947)

### Security

- **(config)** make elevate_with a global-only setting by @jdx in
[#14972](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14972)

### New Contributors

- @deecewan made their first contribution in
[#14992](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14992)
- @HackingGate made their first contribution in
[#14931](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14931)
- @shuaiyafei made their first contribution in
[#14801](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14801)
- @sahidvelji made their first contribution in
[#14949](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/14949)

## 📦 Aqua Registry Updates

### New Packages (2)

- [`glsec/glsec`](https://github.com/glsec/glsec)
- [`yashikota/tlc-static`](https://github.com/yashikota/tlc-static)

### Updated Packages (8)

- [`cloudposse/atmos`](https://github.com/cloudposse/atmos)
- [`jdx/mise`](https://github.com/jdx/mise)
-
[`suzuki-shunsuke/ci-info`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ci-info)
- [`suzuki-shunsuke/cmdx`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/cmdx)
-
[`suzuki-shunsuke/disable-checkout-persist-credentials`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/disable-checkout-persist-credentials)
-
[`suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghalint)
- [`suzuki-shunsuke/ghatm`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/ghatm)
-
[`suzuki-shunsuke/mkghtag`](https://github.com/suzuki-shunsuke/mkghtag)
